scenes.title: 01  |  WELCOME TO SLOTBOOK
scenes.subtitle: A salon booking walkthrough with demo accounts. Passwords stay masked throughout.

scenes.title: 02  |  SERVICES & STYLISTS
scenes.subtitle: Four treatments with transparent prices. Meet Meera and Karan and see their schedules.

scenes.title: 03  |  SIGN IN BEFORE BOOKING
scenes.subtitle: Guests are redirected to login. Their selected treatment is remembered.

scenes.title: 04  |  CREATE A CUSTOMER ACCOUNT
scenes.subtitle: Sign up with a name, a 10-digit phone number and a password.

scenes.title: 05  |  ACCOUNT CREATED
scenes.subtitle: Successful signup returns to the booking page with the customer name and account phone prefilled.

scenes.title: 06  |  NO DUPLICATE PHONE ACCOUNTS
scenes.subtitle: An existing phone number cannot create a second account.

scenes.title: 07  |  CUSTOMER SIGN IN
scenes.subtitle: The phone number and password are checked before the customer can book.

scenes.title: 08  |  SELECT YOUR TREATMENT
scenes.subtitle: Service duration and price update immediately as you choose Haircut, Hair spa, Beard trim or Facial.

scenes.title: 09  |  WEEKLY DAYS OFF
scenes.subtitle: Meera is off on Sundays. The app shows no available slots on her day off.

scenes.title: 10  |  NO PAST-DATE BOOKINGS
scenes.subtitle: Past dates are blocked. The server also rejects times that have already passed today.

scenes.title: 11  |  LIVE AVAILABILITY
scenes.subtitle: Start times use 15-minute steps and account for full service duration, breaks and existing bookings.

scenes.title: 12  |  CUSTOMER DETAILS ARE VALIDATED
scenes.subtitle: Invalid names are rejected before an appointment is saved.

scenes.title: 13  |  ACCOUNT PHONE OR ANOTHER NUMBER
scenes.subtitle: Choose the account number, or enter another contact number. Exactly 10 digits are required.

scenes.title: 14  |  BOOKING CONFIRMED
scenes.subtitle: The confirmation shows the booking ID, service, stylist, time, price and chosen contact number.

scenes.title: 15  |  SAVED IN SQLITE
scenes.subtitle: Refresh the private confirmation link: the saved appointment and contact number remain available.

scenes.title: 16  |  RESCHEDULE WITHOUT CANCELLING
scenes.subtitle: Open the saved appointment to choose a new treatment, stylist, date or time.

scenes.title: 17  |  SAME BOOKING ID, UPDATED APPOINTMENT
scenes.subtitle: The booking is now a 14:00 Facial for 900 rupees. Its ID and contact number are unchanged.

scenes.title: 18  |  NO OVERLAPPING APPOINTMENTS
scenes.subtitle: Booked slots, breaks and the 10-minute cleanup buffer are excluded from new bookings.

scenes.title: 19  |  ANY STYLIST
scenes.subtitle: Combined availability finds an eligible stylist automatically, including during another stylist’s break.

scenes.title: 20  |  CUSTOMERS CANNOT OPEN THE ADMIN DASHBOARD
scenes.subtitle: A customer visiting the admin area is sent to the separate admin sign-in page.

scenes.title: 21  |  ADMIN ID + PHONE + PASSWORD
scenes.subtitle: Each admin uses an owner-assigned special login ID together with their phone number and password.

scenes.title: 22  |  A PRIVATE ADMIN DASHBOARD
scenes.subtitle: Successful admin sign-in opens the dashboard with admin-only navigation and an eight-hour session.

scenes.title: 23  |  DAILY BOOKINGS & REVENUE
scenes.subtitle: Choose a day to view appointments grouped by stylist and total confirmed booking revenue.

scenes.title: 24  |  ADMIN CANCELLATION
scenes.subtitle: Cancel an appointment: the booking count and confirmed revenue update immediately.

scenes.title: 25  |  SIGN-OUT REVOKES ADMIN ACCESS
scenes.subtitle: Signing out ends the admin session and returns to admin sign-in.

scenes.title: 26  |  RETURN AS A CUSTOMER
scenes.subtitle: Customer and admin accounts have separate sessions and separate access permissions.

scenes.title: 27  |  CANCELLED TIMES ARE AVAILABLE AGAIN
scenes.subtitle: The cancelled 14:00 Facial slot is available again for Meera on the same day.

scenes.title: 28  |  RESPONSIVE ON MOBILE
scenes.subtitle: The same booking form adapts to smaller screens, with readable controls and phone-number choices.

scenes.title: 29  |  SLOTBOOK: ALL FEATURES, ONE APP
scenes.subtitle: Accounts, booking rules, rescheduling and private admin controls. The full suite passes 77 tests.
